services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: We provide safe school pick-up from most Public, Catholic, and Private elementary schools and bring students directly to our club. All transportation is handled with care - our vehicles are branded, insured, and licensed for commercial student transport. Kids in our program receive the same high-quality martial arts training offered in our evening classes, meaning they can progress through the curriculum and work toward their black belt just like any other student. blurb: Founded by Master Jang over 15 years ago, Taekwondo Toronto is conveniently located in the heart of Toronto’s West End (Mississauga & Etobicoke) near the Lambton Golf & Country Club on Dundas West of Scarlett. At Taekwondo Toronto, we always strive for Black Belt excellence and value lifelong learning.
